item.text: The workspace is a minimal library with no existing HTTP server, database, authentication layer, or frontend. I’m treating this as a first useful in-memory implementation: a small HTTP API plus a self-contained browser page, with account scoping via `x-account-id` (or a query parameter for the demo UI). The schedule model will support daily/weekly delivery, validated recipients, enable/disable, and a due-delivery endpoint so a worker can dispatch reports later.

The end-to-end slice is in place: account-scoped CRUD, validation, daily/weekly next-run calculation, due-schedule advancement for a delivery worker, and a browser configuration page. I also added tests for invalid input, cross-account access, and due-run progression. I’m running the checks now and will fix any integration issue they expose.

item.text:
Implemented scheduled report delivery.

- Added account-scoped schedule API:
  - `GET/POST /api/schedules`
  - `PATCH/DELETE /api/schedules/:id`
- Added daily and weekly schedules with validated recipients.
- Added due-schedule processing via `dueSchedules()`.
- Added self-service browser UI at `/`.
- Added authorization boundary using `x-account-id`.
- Added focused tests and updated README/scripts.

Verified:

- `npm test` — 4 tests passed.
- `npm run build` — passed.
- Started the service and smoke-tested schedule listing and creation successfully.
